scope: Evaluated Blender source meshes of each denim leg against its corresponding sneaker tongue.
method: Enable one NLA action at a time. For every integer animation frame including both endpoints, build BVHs from the two evaluated world-space meshes and test polygon overlap. Repeat for both feet.
classicGeometryDigestScope: Object names, base vertex positions and face indices across default slots, ordered by slot and object name.

visualReview.observation: Both violet tongues have complete upper edges with denim tucked behind. The white laces remain visible.
Both tongue tips remain continuous across their width. The denim no longer cuts a central notch into either tongue.

limits: Source-level test with integer frame sampling. This report does not evaluate the exported GLB, fractional-frame contacts or intersections with other shoe surfaces.
